verdict.rationale: Gitea documents project boards with columns, issues, milestones, tags, dependencies, and time tracking, which supports task-level organization, but there is no evidence of higher-level roadmap features (e.g., cross-repo roadmaps, timelines, or dedicated roadmap views) beyond basic kanban-style boards. missing for 10: evidence of roadmap/timeline visualization, cross-project planning views, independent hands-on confirmation of project board usability at scale.
